notes: The kept 70 span recent (2016-2025) inflammaging/ageing biology: cellular senescence and SASP (induction, SASP regulation, immune surveillance and evasion, viability, epigenome/3D-genome and proteomic readouts, single-cell senescence in aged tissue); senolytic/senomorphic mechanisms across distinct strategies (BCL-W/XL, beta-gal prodrug, PROTAC, NKG2D-CAR-T, polyamine); NLRP3/cGAS-STING sterile-inflammation drivers framed in ageing (mtDNA, catecholamine catabolism, acetylation switch, YAP-STING, adipose/HSC) plus a few top general mechanisms; clonal haematopoiesis and HSC ageing; omics ageing clocks (methylation pace, organ, inflammatory iAge, single-cell, multi-omic dynamics, CR/metformin geroprotector readouts); immunosenescence; ageing-tissue single-cell/multi-omic findings; and metabolic/mitochondrial drivers (NAD-CD38, cholesterol-lysosome, ER-mito, PAI-1). Citation order was preserved among fitting papers and near-duplicates on one mechanism were pruned for subfield breadth. It deliberately excludes disease-cohort NLRP3/cGAS-STING papers (AD/PD/MS/COVID/arthritis/IBD), inflammasome post-translational-regulation near-duplicates, tools/databases, infection/sepsis studies, and clinical senolytic trial endpoints; it is consequently thin on human proteomic/metabolomic clocks and large population-omics association studies.
